QuestInfo.name: The Terrible Experiment
QuestInfo.2: You met #p9390368#, who says he needs to bribe the leaders of the Zenumists and Alcadnos.

yes.1: Long story short, we need to make contact with the #bZenumist Society#k and the #bAlcadno Society#k.
yes.2: Neinheart says #o8860000# is planning to conduct cruel experiments on the people that were kidnapped.
yes.3: We've concluded that #o8860000# will need top of the line equipment... and that means he's heading to either the #bZenumist Laboratory#k or the #bAlcadno Laboratory#k.
yes.4: I was dispatched to #m261000000#, but it's been difficult to gain access. These people are wary of outsiders.
yes.5: My gameplan is to bribe the laboratories. And that's where you come in.
